target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, headless probe runner, HVF, virtio-ramfb, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-3d-utm-qemu-probe-2026-11-09-rerun.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-3d-apps --probe-keepaway-full-game

checks.GrModels: Man mesh generation reached the repeat prompt with raster output; Ball mesh generation produced an inline sprite with visible pixels; both returned to a working terminal.
checks.KeepAway: Court, HUD and players rendered; Space and mouse input were accepted; scanout changed at each 30-second sample throughout 185 seconds; Escape returned to a terminal where 40+2 returned 42; no Animate child remained.
checks.Titanium: Gameplay frame and input advanced; Escape returned to a terminal where 40+2 returned 42.
checks.runtime_status: The scoped 3D checks reported zstatus failed=0.

scope_note: This used UTM's bundled QEMU framework and virtio-ramfb in a separate headless probe, not the user's live UTM window. It narrows the reported KeepAway freeze to a live-UTM/configuration difference but does not resolve that report. The combined script continued into broad GUI checks after the 3D slice; its final process status was not captured.
